description: Jenkins REST API integration for teams migrating off Jenkins (or living alongside it during the transition). Each declared Jenkins job becomes a daily-partitioned Dagster asset with a retry policy. Ships 5 op-backed jobs (rebuild / disable / enable / stop / reconcile), 2 sensors (external-execution monitor + inbound trigger via Dagster GraphQL), and an hourly reconciliation schedule. demo_mode=true simulates the full REST API lifecycle on stdout so the whole component runs end-to-end with zero external dependencies.

outputs.description: One daily-partitioned Dagster asset per Jenkins job + optional external source-table assets + 5 ops/jobs + 2 sensors + 1 schedule.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate the Jenkins REST API on stdout (no external calls).

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Jenkins controller base URL (used when demo_mode=false). No trailing slash.

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: Jenkins jobs to wrap as daily-partitioned Dagster assets. Each item: {job_name, asset_name, description?, folder?, application?, node_label?, parameters?, run_as?}.

source_tables.label: Source Tables
source_tables.description: Tables loaded by Jenkins that Dagster observes (adds to lineage). Each item: {table_name, asset_name, description?, group_name?, produced_by?}.

upstream_deps.label: Upstream Deps
upstream_deps.description: Upstream asset keys (slash-separated for nested keys) that must complete before jobs run.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for the job assets.

jenkins_user_env.label: Jenkins User Env Var
jenkins_user_env.description: Env var holding the Jenkins REST username.

jenkins_token_env.label: Jenkins Token Env Var
jenkins_token_env.description: Env var holding the Jenkins user's API token.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between Jenkins queue/build status polls.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for terminal result before failing.

partition_start_date.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start_date.description: Start date for the daily partitioned assets.

reconciliation_cron.label: Reconciliation Cron
reconciliation_cron.description: Cron for the Jenkins vs Dagster state reconciliation job.
